openQualificationRequirements: Enumerate all regional/residency, multiple-business, income interaction and company framework/supplement cases against P10/P11.
Pin year-specific official calculation routines, eligibility, rounding rules and schemas; do not reuse one year for another.
Add independently reviewed exact input/output fixtures and reviewer evidence before promoting any case to supported.
Qualify payroll tax codes/bases, NI categories/director methods, schedules, statutory pay, loans, deductions, pensions and combinations.
Retain VAT exemptions, zero/reduced rates, cross-border, reverse charge and unsupported scheme decisions from existing accounting contracts.
registerAcceptanceBoundary: Register completion means declared case scope, required inputs/outputs and acceptance scenarios are reviewed. It does not require or imply implemented engines. P04-03 supplies independent expected-result fixtures and P04-02 implements deterministic rules; promotion to supported remains separately gated.

payrollPrerequisites.scopePolicy: Each variant remains in commercial scope. This family matrix does not claim every combination is qualified; unknown combinations fail closed. Year-specific eligibility and statutory rules must be pinned before calculation.

nextTasks.P04-03: For each family and year, pin official or independently reviewed input/output fixtures, boundary and interaction cases, with reviewer identity.
nextTasks.P04-02: Use those reviewed fixtures to implement explicit precision, rounding, effective rule versions and immutable replay; do not derive expected results from the engine.

families.acceptanceScenario: Create starter, import prior year-to-date, change schedule, leave and rejoin; preserve separate payroll identities and reject conflicting dates.
Combine salary, overtime and arrears with absence and benefit inputs; reconcile each treatment-specific earnings basis without inferring taxable status.
Replay cumulative and non-cumulative runs across region and code changes, irregular pay and refunds against independent official examples; retain earlier results.
Exercise category transitions, both director methods and irregular periods at every applicable threshold; reconcile employee and employer contributions independently.
Verify notice start/stop and concurrent loans, protected earnings ordering, statutory eligibility/recovery and salary-sacrifice interactions; reject unspecified treatment instead of guessing.
Assess and enrol, postpone, opt out and re-enrol synthetic workers; reconcile contribution basis and scheme outputs with effective-dated rules.
Preview and approve identical snapshots, finalise once under retry/concurrency, then correct by linked history; reject stale approvals and unauthorised changes.
Reconcile secure payslips, employer reports and year-end/leaver forms to immutable runs; reject cross-company access and never transmit payment files implicitly.
Prepare and validate synthetic FPS/EPS, recover unknown/rejected responses without duplicate submission, then apply effective notices with audit; no live filing authority inferred.
Run complete gross-to-net cycles through corrections and year rollover, independently reconcile all deductions and employer liabilities, and reproduce prior-year results unchanged.
